review_issue_summaries.summary: gRPC proto contract duplicated verbatim at legacy/cowabunga_sdk/proto and rust/proto with two independent generators and no sync enforcement
README Structure section and all src/ component links describe a layout that no longer exists
Handbook.md instructs dead src/leapfrogai_api paths, a dead module name, and points to a nonexistent LICENSE.bsl
Four package READMEs still list Supabase as a dependent component with dead ../supabase/README.md links; api README names the old artifact
DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md document a Supabase deployment flow that no longer exists
tests/README, legacy evals README, and website docs still link src/leapfrogai_* paths and the leapfrogai bundle name
The initial DB schema exists in three divergent copies applied by three different mechanisms — no single source of truth
packages/api carries dead Supabase migration SQL and an orphaned second zarf package definition in common/
Two UI implementations coexist with no doc explaining which is the product; the packaged image builds the 99-line Leptos placeholder, not the Svelte app every README describes
bundles/dev/cpu contains two byte-identical bundle files plus a third turso variant, with no canonical pointer
Health-check responsibility is split between routers/base.py (/healthz) and routers/health.py (/health, /ready, /live)
legacy/cowabunga_api/config.py is a dead, unimportable 'config' module shadowing the live utils/config.py
crud_base.py has no real docstring: import os precedes a wrong 'CRUD Operations for VectorStore.' literal
CRUDRun.update and CRUDAPIKey.get/list re-implement CRUDBase methods instead of delegating to the shared protocol
delete_message/create_message are implemented twice — routers/openai/messages.py and typedef/threads/thread_create.py — with silently divergent scoping
niah_runner.py and qa_runner.py duplicate the experiment lifecycle (~100 lines) instead of sharing a base runner
tests/pytest/ is named after the test runner while sibling suites are purpose-named, and its test_api.py collides with tests/e2e/test_api.py
Sibling backend packages diverge on entry-point naming: text-embeddings-tiny uses main_tiny.py and vllm uses src/main.py where five siblings use main.py
repeater implements Transcribe/Translate with a different signature than the proto contract and the whisper sibling backend
TursoResult.error is set on every DB failure but never checked by CRUD callers — outages surface as empty results/404s
CRUDBase.get/update return None on pydantic validation failure, conflating corrupt rows with not-found
create/modify vector store catch their own HTTPException(500) and re-raise as 400 'Unable to parse vector store request'
Auth failures raise bare Exception (surfacing as HTTP 500) in the data layer while the session dependency maps equivalent conditions to 401/403
Malformed model config files are logged and skipped; the failure surfaces later as a confusing 'model not found'
Whisper transcribe catches all exceptions and returns empty text — a backend failure is indistinguishable from silent audio
Class COWABUNGA_Model uses SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE and lives in stale-brand module lfai.py
'import cowabunga_sdk as lfai' (81 uses, 12+ production files) aliases the SDK to the retired LeapfrogAI brand
Module leapfrogai_embeddings.py contains class CowabungaAIEmbeddings — path and content disagree
get_session() 'backward compatibility alias' creates a new DatabaseClient; second alias is dead with a false docstring
QA_Runner and NIAH_Runner use snake_case class names against the codebase PascalCase norm
crud_base.py and crud_vector_content.py both claim to be 'CRUD Operations for VectorStore' — wrong for both
database_factory.py keeps two pure-forwarder aliases (get_session, get_database_client) with zero real callers and a stale docstring
MetadataObject is a **kwargs bag used once and immediately converted back to dict via vars() at both call sites
Post-Supabase, the DatabaseClient ABC layer, unused DatabaseConfig, and rpc() string-dispatch with ~130 lines of RPC wrapper classes serve exactly two internal call sites
openai-whisper (torch-heavy) declared but never imported; only faster_whisper is used
Base langchain 0.3.0 meta-package declared but never imported; only satellite packages are used
cowabunga-db declares serde, serde_json, uuid, chrono with zero usage in its source
cowabunga-models declares five deps; 41-line crate uses only serde
Workspace declares refinery migration crate that no crate consumes, misdescribing the hand-rolled migrations
llama-cpp-python pinned at 0.2.72 contradicts the documented >=0.3.x requirement for deployed qwen3 models
dompurify + @types/dompurify declared but every import uses isomorphic-dompurify
cowabunga_evals imports requests and numpy without declaring them
_row_to_model_kwargs is 60 lines of nested fallbacks, silent excepts, inline imports, and a no-op rebind; list() prints to stderr
